{{Current events header|2015|08|9}}

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Arts and culture
*[[Japan]] commemorates the 70th anniversary of the [[Fat Man|atomic bomb]] [[Atomic bombings of Hiroshima and Nagasaki|dropped]] over the [[Japan]]ese city of [[Nagasaki]] during [[World War II]]. [http://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-33839055 (BBC)]
;Disasters and accidents
*[[2015 Pacific typhoon season]]
**At least 22 people are dead or missing in [[China]] and millions are without power after [[Typhoon Soudelor]] hit the nation yesterday. [http://www.usatoday.com/story/weather/2015/08/09/typhoon-weakens-china/31366767/ (''USA Today'')]
;Law and crime
*An arrest warrant has been issued for the cousin of [[Syria|Syrian]] [[President of Syria|President]] [[Bashar al-Assad]], Suleiman Hilal Al-Assad, who is accused of shooting and killing Colonel Hassan Al-Sheikh of the [[Syrian Armed Forces]] at what can be described as a traffic dispute. [https://www.the-newshub.com/international/close-cousin-of-syrian-president-will-be-arrested-for-the-murder (The News Hub)] [http://www.france24.com/en/20150809-syria-protesters-road-rage-assad-relative-accused-civil-war-alawite-latakia (France 24)]
*[[Shooting of Michael Brown]]
**Tyrone Harris, Jr is shot in [[Ferguson, Missouri]] one year after the death of Michael Brown after allegedly firing shots at police. He is in a critical condition.[http://www.stltoday.com/news/local/metro/person-shot-during-protests-late-sunday-in-ferguson/article_baaf86fd-2de0-53a7-b840-1941159aa5c7.html (''St Louis Post-Dispatch'')]
;Politics and elections
*The [[Prime Minister of Iraq]] [[Haider al-Abadi]] calls for abolishing the positions of [[Vice President of Iraq|Vice President]] and Deputy Prime Minister and says he is opening graft investigations. The previous vice president [[Tariq al-Hashimi]] was sentenced to death in absentia over political murders. [http://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2015-08-09/iraq-s-abadi-abolishes-key-government-posts-vows-to-fight-graft (Bloomberg)]
;Sports
*[[National Football League|NFL]] player and sportscaster [[Frank Gifford]] dies at the age of 84. [http://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/nfl-legend-frank-gifford-passes-away-84-n406761 (NBC)]
